description: Exploratory controlled comparison using the same pre-scored candidate pairs as the previous run; test set previously inspected and is not a fresh blind test.
training_candidate_definition: one labelled relevant plus one unjudged candidate; unjudged is not guaranteed irrelevant
notes: Frozen previous teacher checkpoint scores and candidate schedule; three seeds change training randomness but not pair sampling. Soft objective scale differs from hard loss; mixing does not establish equal gradient magnitudes. Query bootstrap excludes variability across trained seeds. No teacher-generated queries.
